headline: Backlog builds, execution improves – the compounding continues

highlights: Operating leverage absorbed a 420bps YoY gross margin compression, holding EBITDA margin at 16.5% (+20bps YoY).
Order inflows (OI) of INR 41bn (+86% YoY) took H1FY27 inflows to INR 92bn (~50% of FY26) and the backlog to INR 333bn.
The order prospects keep on building with strong transmission awarding and approval activity in YTD FY27.
With both HVDC projects in peak execution in FY28/FY29, along with transmission tailwinds supporting OIs, we see strong earnings growth over next three to four years.
valuation: The nation is also targeting 43% of electricity consumption from renewables by 2030.
